scope: Replace the published DistServe crop in both benchmarking chapters with its licensed arXiv original, and record the exact source-attribution guidance for existing Lena Voita artwork without clearing unsupported permission.

review.previousGoalTurn: Progress: completed the Gemma 1–4 architecture comparison and verified the local reader.
review.read: Read the complete preceding RU and EN chapters and the existing figure notice. Re-read and reconciled the changed caption and both plot interpretations.
review.distserve: arXiv v3 §1, Figure 1 and caption. The arXiv article explicitly identifies CC BY-SA 4.0. Only the unchanged arXiv source asset is linked to that license; no assertion that it licenses the earlier USENIX crop.
review.examples: All eight Python blocks in each locale are unchanged and execute in order in uv with NumPy. No GPU test was run.
review.voita: The three course chapters embed all fourteen matched files. The landing page gives the course citation for reuse of materials such as figures. This is attribution guidance, not an explicit named license or clearance of a specific public redistribution. The thirteen author-figure records retain needs-confirmation. The Bahdanau et al. heatmap is independently matched but not covered by the course attribution record; arXiv v7 states a non-exclusive arXiv deposit license.
review.limits: No chapter examples were changed, and no new copy of Voita artwork was made. Publication remains unauthorized; the rest of the public-release inventory is open.
review.reader: Root build: 2069 pages. 272 built-output tests, zero broken links, and 751 publication tests passed (11 skipped). Chromium checked the two DistServe pages and five chapters using the Voita figures at 1280 px and 375 px: 32 successful image load, aspect ratio, fit and attribution observations. Inspected the new chart and its 3× zoom and horizontal pan in both locales.
review.inventory: Scanned the current built HTML for distinct local image paths. 56 active paths have registry status needs-confirmation, one fewer than before this substitution; 45 are linked from textbook routes. No retired image was referenced. The retired DistServe file is absent from the static output. This is a metadata count, not a conclusion about unregistered images or public release.
review.registry: The full curated registry and reader-route figure suites passed 200 tests. The validator covers exact publisher HTML figures, declared arXiv versions, rendered PDF figure sources, pinned author files and archived Qwen crop status. Negative cases reject a different arXiv version, an invented license, a false hash and crop metadata on the unchanged SVG. Rechecked the ASTRA and MoBA files against the pinned author repositories; MoBA's public MIT notice adds only a final newline.

figures.author: Dzmitry Bahdanau, Kyunghyun Cho, Yoshua Bengio (figure); Lena Voita (course reproduction)
